proofUses.reason: One-point logarithmic drifts and pair interactions combine into a stochastic exponential. This proves the full chordal mixed-mark formula for kappa positive, with pair exponent rho_i rho_j/(4 kappa).

Bounded stochastic-logarithm integrand on compact stops gives a true martingale by Novikov and the required force drift by Girsanov. Includes the all-boundary formula and the kappa6 weights (2,-2) specialization; no terminal conditioning claim.

The v1 half-sized interaction exponent leaves a nonzero relative drift, equal to 1/20 in an explicit two-interior-mark example. Version 2, version 3 and the journal already use the corrected exponent; this is a version-specific correction, not a new journal error.
